fusions.name: Ripped Loose
fusions.desc: Hooks the target on a barbed line at up to 6 tiles and rips it loose. The pull deals 9 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and the target moves 30% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Morning Star Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls a studded weight on its links. The whirl deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 0.8 seconds, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Grapnel Haul
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed hook to a spot up to 7 tiles away and hauls you to it instantly. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Next Link
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a barbed line lashes from the body to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles. The lash deals 7 damage and slows the target by 25% for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
